name: logo-enter
title: Logo Enter
description: A stacked, overlapping group of round chips that spring in one by one, then hold. Ships with generic placeholder marks; set the chip count and colours to match your own.
useWhen: A cluster of partner or integration marks should arrive together as an overlapping group.
A positioning or proof beat needs several marks to land stacked.
avoidWhen: You need a single product logo or wordmark lockup: use a logo sting or resolve kinetic text into the name.
The marks must orbit or scatter rather than stack on one axis.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Chips
variables.description: How many chips (1 to 6). Each shows a generic placeholder mark.

variables.label: Diameter
variables.description: Chip diameter in pixels on a 1280x720 frame.

variables.label: Overlap
variables.description: How far each chip tucks under the previous one.

variables.label: Ring
variables.description: Colour of the ring around each chip.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between one chip and the next (30 fps).
